summary_rationale: Uber has completed a structural transformation from a cash-burning blitzscaler into an asset-light, dual-engine marketplace compounder. Across FY2025 and Q3 2026, Gross Bookings compounded at ~20% YoY ($193.5B in FY2025; $59.82B in Q3 2026), GAAP Operating Income doubled to $5,565M in FY2025, and Free Cash Flow reached $9,763M in FY2025 and $10.4B TTM in Q3 2026 (>100% Adjusted EBITDA conversion on 0.6% capex intensity). Uber One (>50M members driving >50% of Mobility+Delivery Gross Bookings) and Advertising (>$2.5B annualized run-rate) reinforce network density and per-share compounding via $10.8B of 2025–9M 2026 buybacks. kpi_health is PASS_WITH_WATCH: core operational KPIs are expanding cleanly, with three watch items requiring ongoing monitoring—autonomous vehicle (Waymo/Tesla) disintermediation risk as commercial fleets scale, U.S. commercial auto insurance cost inflation, and UK VAT merchant-of-record revenue drag.
